resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register's Built field gives 1938, while its description says the tower dates to 1936. The story reports both and keeps 1938 as the structured date. The blog repeats the 1936 wording.
The Register gives AL 35; the blog gives #36. The story follows the Register.

notes_for_editor: Only one tower-specific source (the NHLR entry). The Forest Lookouts page is a header only. The Encyclopedia of Alabama gives a statewide CCC total, not tower detail. No staffing, access or post-2009 condition information was found. The 1936/1938 build conflict is inside the same NHLR entry.
